name: Horizon Sheet Metal Inc
old_description: Horizon Sheet Metal Inc. is the premier provider of custom sheet metal and stainless steel fabrication in Western Massachusetts. Since 1999, we have been providing quality products that meet the demands of the institutional, aviation, automotive, architectural, and electronic industries. We offer a new edition to our company with the introduction of our commercial construction and airport cargo and baggage handling divisions. We welcome you, and please explore our website, which will provide you with further details on our custom products and services, equipment, and company information.
about:
Horizon Sheet Metal Inc. was founded in 1999 in Springfield, Massachusetts, and operates a 30,000-square-foot facility in Western Massachusetts. The company’s ownership structure is not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom sheet metal and stainless steel fabrication from prototype through production runs. Its capabilities include laser cutting (up to 0.75-inch mild steel, 5/8-inch stainless, 3/8-inch aluminum), CNC punching, press-brake bending (up to 12-foot, 187-ton), shearing, saw cutting, rolling, PEM fastener insertion, machining, welding (MIG, TIG, spot, stud), finishing (grinding, polishing, timesaver), and full assembly of enclosures, cabinets, and frames. The facility houses TRUMPF laser and punch systems, multiple press brakes, a 12-foot shear, an Elumatec aluminum extrusion saw, and over 20 Miller welders across ten welding stations.

Horizon serves institutional, aviation, automotive, architectural, and electronic industries, as well as electronics and semiconductor firms, food-service and consumer-food companies, and miscellaneous fabrication clients. The company notes it works with nationally known businesses and institutions and has added commercial construction and airport cargo and baggage handling divisions.

The company emphasizes three differentiators: skilled personnel, fast and precise deliverables enabled by a 4,000-watt laser and CNC sheet metal processing, and reliability in meeting schedules and budgets. It states that its team identifies critical project factors early to deliver superior results with extreme attention to detail.
